content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Mangalagiri
content_sections.text: AIIMS Mangalagiri is described in the notice as a healthcare Institute of National Importance, established by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojna (PMSSY). Its address is Guntur Dist., Andhra Pradesh, 522503. The notice is signed by the Registrar.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 3 vacancies in two departments. Reservation for OBC/EWS/SC/ST is as per Central Government rules, and 4% is reserved for PwBD candidates on a horizontal basis.

content_sections.text: The notice marks the qualification with an asterisk: a postgraduate medical degree from a recognized university/Institute or equivalent qualification thereto. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Medical candidates are paid as per the 7th CPC at Pay Level-11 of the Pay Matrix, with an entry pay of Rs. 67,700 plus NPA and other allowances. Non-medical candidates (M.Sc with Ph.D) receive Rs. 56,100 in Level-10 under the 7th CPC plus other allowances. The appointment is as per the Government of India's Residency Scheme, for a maximum of 3 years. The appointee is on a whole-time appointment of AIIMS for 12 months at a time, continued up to 3 years on the recommendation of the HOD and at the discretion of the Competent Authority. Either side may end the appointment by giving one month's notice or paying one month's salary, without assigning any reason. It can also be terminated for failure to complete a period of three months to the satisfaction of the competent authority. The appointee shall not take any other assignment, paid or otherwise, and private practice of any type is strictly prohibited. The appointee is not entitled to Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion or other benefits available to regular Government servants. Leave is granted as per Institute rules and Government of India instructions. The appointee may work in shifts and can be posted at any place in the Institute. Selected candidates get 14 days to join; an extension may be granted in exceptional situations. If the candidate does not join in time, the offer stands cancelled and may go to a waitlisted candidate, if any. The offer of appointment is provisional and subject to verification of credentials and to the candidate being declared medically fit by the competent Medical Board.

content_sections.text: One set of self-attested photocopies is to be produced with the originals at document verification before the interview. The notice's Annexure-II checklist names: Original application form (Annexure-I) and the filled Proforma/Check list (Annexure-II) Identity proof (preferably Aadhar Card) Certificate showing date of birth (10th certificate or birth certificate) MBBS/M.Sc/BDS (UG) marksheets and certificates; MD/MS/DNB/DM/M.Ch marksheets and certificates Attempt certificate (for MBBS and Post Graduation); FMGE certificate conducted by NBE (for foreign graduates) Registration with Medical Council of India/State Medical Council/Dental Council of India or State No Objection Certificate for Govt./Semi-Govt./PSU employees Experience certificate, publications and reservation category certificate (EWS/OBC/SC/ST/PwBD) Internship completion certificate and any other relevant documents

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Mangalagiri Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 in Anatomy and 2 in Medical Haemotalogy. By category, the notice shows 2 UR and 1 ST.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The closing date of applications is 12 December 2026 (Saturday). The notice states there is no walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the posts?
faq.answer: Anatomy needs MD/DNB in Anatomy, or M.Sc/M.Biotech in the subject concerned with Ph.D. in the subject concerned/allied subject. Medical Haemotalogy needs MD/DNB in Medicine/Paediatrics or DM/DrNB (Clinical Haematology).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years as on the closing date of application. SC/ST get up to 5 years' relaxation and OBC up to 3 years; PwBD get 10, 13 or 15 years by category.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Medical candidates get Pay Level-11 with an entry pay of Rs. 67,700 plus NPA and other allowances. Non-medical candidates (M.Sc with Ph.D) get Rs. 56,100 in Level-10 plus other allowances.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: General/EWS/OBC candidates pay Rs. 1500/- and SC/ST candidates pay Rs. 1000/-, through NEFT/UPI. PwBD candidates pay no fee, and the fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the Google Form given in the notice and upload the scanned application in the prescribed format with documents and fee transaction details. The filled original forms are submitted at document verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is by interview only. If many candidates apply, an MCQ screening test in the subject concerned is held first, followed by the interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is under the Government of India's Residency Scheme for a maximum of 3 years, in 12-month periods, and carries no Provident Fund, Pension or Gratuity.

faq.question: Q10. Do I need an NOC to apply?
faq.answer: Applicants working in Central/State Government, Semi Government or Autonomous Institutions must produce an original NOC at the interview. They are allowed to appear for the interview only on producing it.
